change_reason: Initial registry for the Role 1 correlation engine. Every weight, threshold and window is a PROVISIONAL starting point, not an empirically established value.

calibration.note: Not calibrated. Weights, thresholds and collision factors are expert-judgement placeholders until validated on representative labelled data (see evaluate.py). Synthetic benchmark results do not establish real-world accuracy.

score_model.formula: S = clamp( sum(weight x feature x reliability) - sum(collision) - sum(penalty x contradiction) )

T_REVIEW.meaning: T_REVIEW <= score < T_HIGH: requires analyst review; below T_REVIEW is excluded from default results

candidate_generation.note: ip and device hub thresholds and the 600 s / 1800 s windows are copied from the existing T5 engine (intelligence/correlate.py, intelligence/config.py); domain and filename thresholds and max_bucket_size are new PROVISIONAL values. Candidate generation is not evidence.

reference_data.note: Generic seed lists (PROVISIONAL), not exhaustive. ordered_action_pairs are the T5 ORDERED_PAIRS plus (dns_query, network_connection). alias_groups is empty by default: aliases are case-specific analyst input and are never inferred.

parameters.description: Both events carry the same well-formed 64-hex SHA-256 of the same content (file or attachment) and neither event's evidence is quarantined, removed or failing verification. A filename, IP address or timestamp can never anchor.
parameters.change_reason: Initial PROVISIONAL registry (corr-registry-v1); values are uncalibrated starting points.

positive.label: same 64-hex SHA-256 on an email attachment and an uploaded file object

negative.label: same file name, different hashes: no anchor

parameters.description: Both events carry the same well-formed Message-ID (<local@domain>): the same message observed twice (e.g. sent copy and received copy).

parameters.description: One event's In-Reply-To/References header names the other event's Message-ID: an explicit, directed reply/forward link.

parameters.description: Same thread/conversation identifier, valid only inside one source and one account namespace (Gmail threadId and Outlook conversationId are not global). An identifier with no account scope is rejected, never anchored.

parameters.description: Same network session identifier (e.g. Zeek uid) inside the same capture or, failing that, the same evidence file. Session identifiers are only unique within a capture.
